test_check_python: test the doctor.check_python function that verifies the current Python version meets the minimum requirement
test_check_config_exists: test the doctor.check_config_exists function that checks whether a config.yaml file is present at a given path
test_check_config_version: test the doctor.check_config_version function that compares config version against the example config
test_check_models_configured: test the doctor.check_models_configured function that validates models are configured in config.yaml
test_check_llm_api_key: test the doctor.check_llm_api_key function that verifies LLM API keys are set in the environment
test_check_llm_auth: test the doctor.check_llm_auth function that validates LLM authentication for codex and claude providers
test_check_web_search: test the doctor.check_web_search function that verifies web search tools like DuckDuckGo or Tavily are configured
test_check_web_fetch: test the doctor.check_web_fetch function that verifies web fetch tools like Jina AI or Firecrawl are configured
test_check_sandbox: test the doctor.check_sandbox function that validates sandbox provider configuration and runtime availability
test_main_exit_code: test the doctor.main function that runs all checks and returns an exit code
